question: Which of the following is NOT related to Western Ghats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahendragiri Hills**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mahendragiri Hills** are not part of the Western Ghats.
 
• The Western Ghats, also known as the Sahyadri Hills, include several important mountain ranges such as the Nilgiri Hills, Anaimalai Hills, and Sahyadri Hills.
